parameters.experiment: Q3 intraday load correction with its own q75 protection: S0_L75 vs S2_load_q75
parameters.specification: reports\问题三\问题三_日内负载修正与q75费用对照实验方案.md

groups.S0_L75: forward-archive F0 load (the original 0:00 forecast) + attachment-3 Linear PV + the saved own W28/q75; read-only reuse of the audited ledger
groups.S2_load_q75: forward-archive F2 load (0:00 original, revised at 6/12/18) + the same Linear PV + a W28/q75 rebuilt from F2's own published errors

parameters.identification: the difference measures the combined effect of the F2 load correction, its matching residual protection and the dispatch response. It is NOT the isolated value of same-day information and says nothing about F1.
parameters.net_forecast: n_hat[k,v,h] = (load_hat[k,v,h] - pv_linear[k,v,h]) * dt; n = (L - V) * dt; eps = n - n_hat, all in kWh

history.rule: d in [max(0,k-28), k-1] with 144d + h + 1 <= 144k + 6*r_v, that publication's prediction and the target truth valid
history.quantile: ascending order statistic at position ceil(0.75 m); zero when m < 7; negative protection retained
history.separation: the 14-day weight fit of the F2 forecast and the 7-day q75 history are different mechanisms and are never mixed; F2 uses its own stored published values, never F0/F1 errors or current parameters backfilled

parameters.engine: unchanged rolling kernel: power cap 5000 kW (5000/6 kWh per slot), state band 1200-10800 kWh, charge/discharge efficiency 0.9 each, free terminal, no selling and no new penalty; the 0:00 plan minimises sum p q0, intraday revisions minimise sum [p q + 0.5 p |q - q0|]; accept a candidate only if its greedy score beats the previous plan by more than 1e-4 yuan
parameters.settlement: C = sum over the final effective purchase of [p q_eff + 0.5 p |q_eff - q0| + 5 p e] on the delivery-interval price; no repeated adjustment fee across overwrites; the midnight carry keeps the original commitment of its owning day

ledgers.B: full 48097-segment trajectory including the 2026-01-01 00:00-00:10 tail, not part of the main cost
ledgers.template: [2025-02-01 00:10, 2026-01-01 00:10), reported separately and bridged by the head/tail difference; the two ledgers are never summed up as one

parameters.gate: delta C = C_S2 - C_S0 on the natural ledger; |delta| <= 0.0001 yuan is numerically tied; lower cash supports only 'cheaper in this one-year fixed configuration'. No automatic model replacement and no result3.xlsx write.
parameters.solver: HiGHS via scipy.optimize.milp, the same binary mutual-exclusion formulation and tolerances as the accepted kernel
parameters.validation: three light checks: input and protection boundary (0 MILP), two adaptation solves (2 MILP), persisted-ledger reconciliation (0 MILP)

dependency.kernel: code/q3_rolling_baseline_experiment.py imported as a read-only library
dependency.note: the protection rebuild is pure array arithmetic and is NOT reported as zero work
